primary_sources.title: MIL-HDBK-310, Global Climatic Data for Developing Military Products, 23 June 1997
primary_sources.limitations: Marginal extremes are not a complete joint weather day. Sea-level low-pressure quantiles are absent from Table XXVI. Surface values are mapped to altitude by explicitly projected profiles. No annual/local availability inferred.

primary_sources.title: Vömel, Water Vapor Pressure Formulations, NSF NCAR EOL
primary_sources.used: Buck 1996 updated water and ice saturation formulae
primary_sources.correction: model50.py's es_water docstring says Buck (1981). Its actual coefficients are the 1996 update; numeric results use the displayed updated formula. Code was preserved after the retry request pin.
primary_sources.limitations: Pure saturation curve; pressure enhancement and real-gas corrections omitted. RH in the weather grid is relative to liquid water, including below freezing.

primary_sources.title: Dong et al., Fundamental Limits of the Dew-Harvesting Technology
primary_sources.used: Equations 1--3: coupled radiative/convection/latent-energy balance and Lewis heat/mass analogy; Le=.87, exponent -2/3.
primary_sources.limitations: The paper's condenser and spectral atmosphere are not this sphere. Our grey-sky, two-skin enthalpy model is a new PROJECTION; no experimental deposition result is transferred as a hull measurement.

primary_sources.title: NIST-JANAF Be(cr) heat-capacity table
primary_sources.used: Room-temperature scale for a rounded 1825 J/(kg K) heat capacity; table varies with temperature.
primary_sources.limitations: Fixed room-temperature capacity is a planning approximation, especially for the cold frost case.

primary_sources.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook aluminum solid Shomate heat capacity
primary_sources.used: Room-temperature scale for rounded 900 J/(kg K) aluminum-core capacity.
primary_sources.limitations: Constant capacity and bulk-metal transfer to honeycomb; polymer heat capacity omitted.
